item.title: Pentagon–Anthropic clash: AI limits on autonomous weapons trigger dispute over Trump’s Golden Dome defence plan
item.description: The Pentagon’s dispute with AI company Anthropic intensified after disagreements over using artificial intelligence in autonomous weapons tied to President Donald Trump’s Golden Dome missile defence program. U.S. officials said Anthropic’s restrictions on military applications of its AI model Claude conflicted with plans for autonomous drone swarms and advanced defense systems.

item.title: Uber comes into Intercity Bus ticket starting from India
item.description: Uber has partnered with Ixigo’s AbhiBus and entered the intercity bus ticketing on their app. Uber is putting out a 25 per cent discount (up to Rs 200) on their first Uber Intercity Bus ride, and about a 10 per cent discount (up to Rs 100) on their next three rides as part of the introductory offer.

item.title: Indian refiners rush to buy Russian crude after US relaxation amid conflict with Iran
item.description: Tankers loaded with Russian crude are being picked up by Indian refiners who are rushing to utilise the 30-day window given by the US. Russian crude is available at a discount but Indian refiners cannot buy it since they are restrained by US diktats.

item.title: Gangster Lawrence Bishnoi, 2 others acquitted in extortion case, court sites lack of evidence
item.description: The court acquitted gangster Lawrence Bishnoi and 2 others in an extortion case, filed by Delhi Police. The court said that there was lack of evidence against the accused. A lawyer had filed a complaint saying that he received an extortion call, demanding Rs 1 crore in April 2023. The court however, said that the police failed to prove role of Bishnoi and others in the matter.
